---
title: "Sensitivity Analysis: Age Moderation"
author: "XXXX"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

This file tests whether the same-month associations between identity development experiences and stress and distress differ across the 16 to 27 age range (Supplementary Material S4; Table S14).

The final model is re-estimated with an interaction between each monthly identity experience count and age (centred on the sample mean) predicting the stress and distress deviations:

* interactions and direct age effects on the deviations are held equal across waves, matching the main effects
* the interaction terms are predicted by the same covariates as the counts, and each covaries with its count, so missing values are handled in the same way
* a joint Wald test checks whether both interactions are zero
* simple slopes give the identity experience effects at the mean age, at 1 SD above and below it, and at ages 16 and 27

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(MplusAutomation)

# Set WD
set.seed(123)
setwd("C:XXXX")

# Import data
GZMCore <- readRDS("C:XXXX")

# Fit indices reported in the tables
fit_cols <- c("Title", "Parameters", "ChiSqM_Value", "ChiSqM_DF", "ChiSqM_PValue",
              "CFI", "RMSEA_Estimate", "RMSEA_90CI_LB", "RMSEA_90CI_UB", "SRMR", "AIC", "BIC")
```

# Mplus Data

```{r mplus data}
GZMCore <- GZMCore %>%
  mutate(
    # Proximal minority stress composite (x) and distress (y), W0 to W4
    x1 = StressComp_W0, x2 = StressComp_W1, x3 = StressComp_W2, x4 = StressComp_W3, x5 = StressComp_W4,
    y1 = DASS_Total_W0, y2 = DASS_Total_W1, y3 = DASS_Total_W2, y4 = DASS_Total_W3, y5 = DASS_Total_W4,

    # Gender: 0 = cisgender, 1 = trans or gender diverse
    gender = case_when(GenderGroup %in% c(1, 2) ~ 0, GenderGroup %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6) ~ 1),

    # Ethnoracial identity: 0 = White, 1 = People of Colour
    race = case_when(RaceAnalysis == 1 ~ 0, RaceAnalysis == 2 ~ 1),

    # Age and baseline (lifetime) identity experience count, centred on the sample mean
    Age0    = Age - mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    msbase0 = msbase - mean(msbase, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Baseline distress group: 0 = at or below the median, 1 = above the median
    dgrp = case_when(y1 <= median(y1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0, y1 > median(y1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1)
  )

# Identity experience count x age (missing if either is missing)
GZMCore <- GZMCore %>%
  mutate(
    ma2 = m_W1 * Age0,
    ma3 = m_W2 * Age0,
    ma4 = m_W3 * Age0,
    ma5 = m_W4 * Age0
  )

mplus_age <- GZMCore %>%
  select(m_W1, m_W2, m_W3, m_W4, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, y1, y2, y3, y4, y5,
         msbase0, Age0, gender, race, dgrp, ma2, ma3, ma4, ma5)
mplus_age[is.na(mplus_age)] <- -99
prepareMplusData(mplus_age, "modelage.dat")
```

```{r ages for simple slopes}
# The simple slopes in the model use these values (age centred on the mean)
age_mean <- mean(GZMCore$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
age_sd   <- sd(GZMCore$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
round(c(Mean = age_mean, SD = age_sd, Age16 = 16 - age_mean, Age27 = 27 - age_mean), 3)
```

# Model

The model matches the final model except for the blocks marked AGE MODERATION.

```{r age moderation model}
mplusSyntaxAge <- ("
TITLE: AGE_MOD Final conditional LCM-SR + SIDE x age interactions;

DATA:
  FILE = modelage.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp ma2-ma5;
  USEVARIABLES = m2-m5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp ma2-ma5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  ! Stress trajectory - freed time scores
  ix sx | x1@0 x2@0.126 x3@-0.194 x4@-0.695 x5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  ! Distress trajectory - fixed slope
  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ! Between-person cross-construct covariances
  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;

  [x1-x5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  ! Stress structured residuals
  rx1 BY x1@1; rx2 BY x2@1; rx3 BY x3@1; rx4 BY x4@1; rx5 BY x5@1;
  [rx1-rx5@0];
  x1-x5@0;

  ! Distress structured residuals
  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  rx1;
  rx2-rx5 (vsx);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);

  ! Stress AR - equality constrained
  rx2 ON rx1 (arx);
  rx3 ON rx2 (arx);
  rx4 ON rx3 (arx);
  rx5 ON rx4 (arx);

  ! Distress AR - freely estimated
  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  ! Within-time covariances - freely estimated
  rx1 WITH ry1;
  rx2 WITH ry2;
  rx3 WITH ry3;
  rx4 WITH ry4;
  rx5 WITH ry5;

  ! Contemporaneous SIDE effects - equality constrained across waves
  rx2 ON m2 (sides_x_con);
  rx3 ON m3 (sides_x_con);
  rx4 ON m4 (sides_x_con);
  rx5 ON m5 (sides_x_con);

  ry2 ON m2 (sides_y_con);
  ry3 ON m3 (sides_y_con);
  ry4 ON m4 (sides_y_con);
  ry5 ON m5 (sides_y_con);

  ! AGE MODERATION: SIDE x age interactions - equality constrained
  rx2 ON ma2 (int_x);
  rx3 ON ma3 (int_x);
  rx4 ON ma4 (int_x);
  rx5 ON ma5 (int_x);

  ry2 ON ma2 (int_y);
  ry3 ON ma3 (int_y);
  ry4 ON ma4 (int_y);
  ry5 ON ma5 (int_y);

  ! AGE MODERATION: direct age effects on residuals - equality constrained
  rx2 ON Age0 (age_x);
  rx3 ON Age0 (age_x);
  rx4 ON Age0 (age_x);
  rx5 ON Age0 (age_x);

  ry2 ON Age0 (age_y);
  ry3 ON Age0 (age_y);
  ry4 ON Age0 (age_y);
  ry5 ON Age0 (age_y);

  ! Time-invariant covariates predicting growth factors
  ix ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  sx ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  iy ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;

  ! Time-invariant covariates predicting SIDE counts and products
  m2-m5 ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  ma2-ma5 ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;

  ! AGE MODERATION: each product covaries with its SIDE count
  m2 WITH ma2;
  m3 WITH ma3;
  m4 WITH ma4;
  m5 WITH ma5;

MODEL TEST:
  ! Joint test: SIDE x age interactions on stress and distress = 0
  0 = int_x;
  0 = int_y;

MODEL CONSTRAINT:
  ! Simple slopes: SIDE effect at given ages (Age0 values)
  ! -1 SD and +1 SD = -/+2.934 years; age 16 = -5.878; age 27 = 5.122
  ! (sample mean age 21.878, SD 2.934; checked in the chunk above)
  NEW(x_lo x_mean x_hi x_16 x_27 y_lo y_mean y_hi y_16 y_27);
  x_lo   = sides_x_con + int_x*(-2.9340);
  x_mean = sides_x_con;
  x_hi   = sides_x_con + int_x*(2.9340);
  x_16   = sides_x_con + int_x*(-5.8780);
  x_27   = sides_x_con + int_x*(5.1220);
  y_lo   = sides_y_con + int_y*(-2.9340);
  y_mean = sides_y_con;
  y_hi   = sides_y_con + int_y*(2.9340);
  y_16   = sides_y_con + int_y*(-5.8780);
  y_27   = sides_y_con + int_y*(5.1220);

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxAge, "modelage.inp")
runModels("modelage.inp")
```

# Results

```{r admissibility and fit}
# Warning lines in the output (none = admissible)
grep("NOT POSITIVE DEFINITE|NEGATIVE|NO CONVERGENCE", readLines("modelage.out"), value = TRUE)

age_model <- readModels("modelage.out", what = c("summaries", "parameters"))
select(age_model$summaries, any_of(fit_cols))

# Wald test: both interactions = 0
select(age_model$summaries, WaldChiSq_Value, WaldChiSq_DF, WaldChiSq_PValue)
```

```{r table s14}
table_s14 <- age_model$parameters$stdyx.standardized %>%
  left_join(select(age_model$parameters$ci.stdyx.standardized, paramHeader, param, low2.5, up2.5),
            by = c("paramHeader", "param"))
write.csv(table_s14, "TableS14_age_moderation.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Key results: identity experience effects (M), interactions (MA) and age effects on the deviations
filter(table_s14, grepl("^R[XY][2-5]\\.ON$", paramHeader),
       param %in% c("M2", "M3", "M4", "M5", "MA2", "MA3", "MA4", "MA5", "AGE0"))
```

```{r simple slopes}
# Unstandardised identity experience effects at each age
# X = stress, Y = distress; LO/HI = -1 SD/+1 SD; 16 and 27 = ages 16 and 27
filter(age_model$parameters$unstandardized, paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters")
```
